name: Shop & Inventory
description: Purchase items and manage your inventory

commands.name: shop
commands.description: View and purchase items from the shop
commands.longDescription: Browse and buy items with your coins. The shop currently stocks bank upgrades.

examples.output:
🛒 Economy Shop

Your wallet: 🪙 5,000

💰 Economy Items
🏦 Bank Expansion - 🪙 2,000
Increases bank capacity by 🪙 1,000

tips: Bank Expansion increases your bank capacity by 1,000 coins
Buttons are disabled for items you cannot afford
Coins in the bank are separate from your wallet - check both with /balance

commands.name: inventory
commands.longDescription: View your owned items and sell them back for coins.

examples.output:
📦 Your Inventory

🔤 Wordle Collectibles
🔤 Lucky Letter x2 (🪙 500 each)

tips: The Lucky Letter is awarded for being first to solve a Wordle
Items sell for their full base value
